blocks.text: Let's look at this one. Match each equation with its solution. Undo the operation, then check.
blocks.display: Match each equation with its solution.

blocks.text: Subtract four from both sides: eleven minus four is seven.
Add five to both sides: three plus five is eight.
Divide both sides by six: thirty divided by six is five.
Multiply both sides by three: four times three is twelve.
Each equation now has its solution. Undo each operation with its inverse, on both sides, and you can always check by putting the answer back.
